text:
sam: Heads up — promo for v2026.3 is blocked, `pack-artifacts` step failed in CI. error: checksum mismatch during wheel upload. gist of logs below:
```
Uploading package myservice-2026.3-py3-none.whl
PUT https://artifacts.internal/upload -> 200
Verifying checksum... expected=sha256:abcd1234 got=sha256:abce1235
ERROR: checksum mismatch, aborting publish
```
sam: deploybot also reports promotion paused: @deploybot any more detail?
deploybot: Promotion blocked: upstream artifact verification failed (code: ARTIFACT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH). Automatic rollback disabled for reserved promos. See https://ci.internal/build/31245
eva: ugh. this looks like upload truncated or the builder had a stray cache hit. can we reupload the same build artifacts from the job workspace?
sam: runner node finished and GC'd workspace already. the job logs include `twine upload` success but server-side verification fails. suspect corrupt cache / s3 multipart chunk reorder.
jordan: change window is 14:00-15:00 PT. if we can't unblock by 14:10 we should pin last-stable and manual-promote to avoid missing window.
eva: agreed. options: 1) re-run the pipeline with `--no-cache` and force publish 2) rebuild/reupload artifacts from the commit 3) pin to release candidate from yesterday (v2026.2).
sam: trying option 1 now — triggering a rerun with cache disabled: `bk run 31245 --no-cache --task pack-artifacts`
sam: FYI logs show intermittent 503s to artifact-store during multipart commit. maybe transient. if rerun still fails we should pin.
deploybot: Canary promotion suspended for v2026.3. Auto-fallback: NONE. Notifying release-coordinator.
release-coordinator: Thanks — if rerun works, call it out here and we'll proceed with normal promo. If rerun fails, we will pin to `v2026.2` and add a postmortem item. Decision window set to 14:10 PT.
eva: rerun started (ci/31245#2). I'll tail the pack step.
sam: pack step still failing at 14:05 PT with same checksum diff. starting a manual rebuild w/ clean deps now and will attempt to publish with `--retries 5`
eva: should we also try reuploading the artifact file directly from the buildkite agent to the store (bypassing multipart)? if multipart is the culprit that could work.
sam: good call — spinning up ephemeral runner to push single PUT artifact. command: `curl -X PUT --data-binary @myservice.whl https://artifacts.internal/upload?commit=sha1-abc --header "X-Checksum: sha256:abcd1234"`
sam: upload returned 200 but verification still failed. same got=sha256:abce1235. looks like server is recomputing from stored bytes and it's different. either source file corrupted before upload or store modified it.
jordan: at 14:09 PT we need decision. release-coordinator?
release-coordinator: Given time, pin to `v2026.2` for the change window. We will not risk a partial promo. Sam, open a ticket to investigate artifact-store multipart integrity and attach traces. Add `release: rollback` to the ticket.
sam: pinned `v2026.2` in the release dashboard and triggered manual promote. deploybot, please promote `v2026.2` to prod.
deploybot: Manual promote requested for tag `v2026.2` by sam. Promotion queued and will run postchecks.
eva: leaving a quick note for release notes: "Promo delayed: artifact-store checksum failure; pinned v2026.2 to keep change window. Investigating multipart upload integrity."
release-coordinator: Good. We'll schedule postmortem and notify customer-facing comms if any customers asked about changes. I'll own the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
sam: created ticket ARTIFACTS-774 and attached logs + build IDs.
jordan: thanks all. moving this thread to incidents if we need follow-up. :thumbsup:
